description: A publisher-controlled element that renders on top of buyer creative content within the ad placement. Creative agents should avoid placing critical content (CTAs, logos, key copy) within overlay bounds.

bounds.description: Position and size of the overlay relative to the asset's own top-left corner. See 'unit' for coordinate interpretation.

unit.description: 'px' = absolute pixels from asset top-left. 'fraction' = proportional to asset dimensions (x/y: 0.0 = asset edge, 1.0 = opposite edge; width/height: 0.12 = 12% of asset dimension).

x.description: Horizontal offset from the asset's left edge

y.description: Vertical offset from the asset's top edge

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what this overlay is and how buyers should account for it

visual.description: Optional visual reference for this overlay element. Useful for creative agents compositing previews and for buyers understanding what will appear over their content. Must include at least one of: url, light, or dark.

dark.description: URL to the overlay graphic for use on dark backgrounds (SVG or PNG)

light.description: URL to the overlay graphic for use on light/bright backgrounds (SVG or PNG)

url.description: URL to a theme-neutral overlay graphic (SVG or PNG). Use when a single file works for all backgrounds, e.g. an SVG using CSS custom properties or currentColor.

title: Overlay
